document_api_meta.title: Create Custom Engagement Task
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Create an engagement task that uses a self-defined custom message instead of predefined message templates from TikTok Shop. The task acts as a container for grouping messages with similar content and rules, allowing sellers to track and compare task performance across different types of content.
Note that each task has a mandatory end time, and once expired, it cannot be used to send additional messages.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: idempotency_key
request_query_param.desc:
A unique key to recognize a request and prevent duplicate processing of the same request, especially in cases of connection issues. Ensure this key is unique for each request to avoid accidental duplicates.
Note: We recommend that you generate v4 UUIDs for use as keys.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: task_name
request_body_param.desc: The name of the task.

request_body_param.name: end_time
request_body_param.desc: The time at which the task ends, and messages will no longer be sent. Unix timestamp (seconds).

request_body_param.name: channel
request_body_param.desc: The engagement channel. Only `TIKTOK_IM` is supported.

request_body_param.name: product_ids
request_body_param.desc:
The product IDs that you want to include as interactive cards in the message. Retrieve this value from the [Search Products API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/65854ffb8f559302d8a6acda).
Max count: 4

request_body_param.name: coupon_ids
request_body_param.desc:
The coupon IDs that you want to include as interactive cards in the message. 
Max count: 1
You can only add coupons that have one of these sets of property:
- `coupons.display_type=REGULAR` and `coupons.target_buyer_segment=ALL`
- `coupons.display_type=REGULAR` and `coupons.target_buyer_segment=REPEAT_CUSTOMERS`.
Find out the coupon ID and properties from the [Search Coupons API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6699dcdf115ebe02f841e4cd).

request_body_param.name: custom_message
request_body_param.desc: The custom message to send to customers.

request_body_param.name: ^title
request_body_param.desc:
The message title. 
- Valid format: plain text, unicode emoji (UTF-8)
- Valid length: [1, 70]

request_body_param.name: ^body
request_body_param.desc:
The message body.
- Valid format: plain text, unicode emoji (UTF-8)
- Valid length:  [1, 500]

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^task_id
response_param.desc: The unique identifier for the customer engagement task. Pass this value in the [Send Engagement Message API](67777e448e882e030d29676e) to associate the task with the message sending operation.

request_body_param.name: order_ids

The orders must follow the restrictions:
- Each of the orders must exist and be RTS and shipping label printed.
- The orders are sent by the same seller.
- The orders belong to a single group of TikTok Shop service districts. The groups are:

  - Group 2: DE, FR, IT, ES.

You can not create first mile bundles for US/UK orders using this API.

- `PICKUP`: You use the logistic service provided by TikTok Shop to send the bundle.
- `DROP_OFF`: You contact the logistic provider and send the bundle. The logistic provider must be registered at TikTok Shop.

request_body_param.desc: The logistic provider ID in TikTok Shop. Required when `handover_method == DROP_OFF`.

request_body_param.name: tracking_number

Possible values:
- `TO FULFILL`：Waiting for the merchant or warehouse to ship the package.
- `PROCESSING`: Package has been arranged by seller. Waiting for carrier to collect the parcel.
- `FULFILLING`: Package has been collected by carrier and in transit.
- `COMPLETED`: Package has been delivered.
- `CANCELLED`: Package has been canceled. Normally, the package is canceled due to the package being lost or damaged.

response_param.name: ^package_sub_status
response_param.desc:
-ISSUE：Package allocation failed, need to contact the platform.

-STOCKING：Platform verification completed, waiting for the merchant to ship
-RTSING：Purchasing shipping label and waiting for the carrier to return results.
-RTS_success：Purchasing shipping label success,seller can print label.
-HBW:Only for FBT order ,has been create to the warehouse
-HBWING:Only for FBT order ,creating to the warehouse
-TTS：Carriers pickup the package.
-Delivery：The package has been delivered to the buyer.
-Ship_exception：Cannot delivered to buyer, maybe damaged or lost.

request_query_param.name: document_type
request_query_param.desc:
Available document types: 
- `SHIPPING_LABEL`: Returns the shipping label in PDF format by default.
- `PACKING_SLIP`: Returns the packing slip in PDF format by default.
- `SHIPPING_LABEL_AND_PACKING_SLIP`: Returns both the shipping label and the packing slip for the package, both in PDF format by default.              
- `SHIPPING_LABEL_PICTURE`: Returns the shipping label in PNG format. 
- `HAZMAT_LABEL`: Returns the hazmat label in PDF format by default. You must only use this value when there are hazmat items in the package. When you use the value, `document_size` is fixed to A4, and you don't need to specify `document_size`.
- `INVOICE_LABEL`: For Brazil market only, document_size is fixed to A6, and you don't need to specify `document_size`. Returns the invoice label in PDF format by default

request_query_param.name: document_size
request_query_param.desc:
Use this field to specify the size of the document to obtain. This parameter is only applicable to shipping labels, picking slips, and packing slips that are in the PDF format. It is not applicable for hazmat labels as these are fixed to A4. 
If you specify `SHIPPING_LABEL_PICTURE` for the `document_type`, any value specified in the `document_size` will be ignored. 

Possible values: 
- `A6` (Default)
- `A5`

request_query_param.name: document_format
request_query_param.desc:
The format of the shipping document.
Possible values: 
- PDF (Default)
- ZPL (Only for BR and MX market)

**Note**: Not applicable for `SHIPPING_LABEL_PICTURE` document type.

request_query_param.name: shipping_period

- DEFAULT (Default)
- LAST_MILE (Only cross-border services under the 4PL model with the business solution of 3PL for main transport & customs clearance + 4PL for last-mile delivery will return the last-mile shipping label; calls from all other scenarios will be invalid.

document_api_meta.title: Ship Package
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Use this API to ship a package. There are two kinds of shipping options available: `TikTok Shipping` or `Seller Shipping`.

- `TikTok Shipping`: Schedule a package handover time for TikTok Shipping carriers to pickup a package from seller.
- `Seller Shipping`: Seller arranges their own shipping, and uploads a tracking number and `shipping_provider_id`. Package ID can be obtained from [Get Order Detail](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa8ccc16ffe02b8f167a0?external_id=650aa8ccc16ffe02b8f167a0#Back%20To%20Top).

document_api_meta.title: Split Orders
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Use this API to confirm an order split. Note that ​​supported split levels vary by region​​:
- Some regions support ​​item-level splits​​ (splitting individual units of the same SKU).
- Others only support ​​all-units splits​​ (splitting different SKUs into separate packages).

Here are two examples of supported splits:
- ​​**Case 1**: all-units split​​, applicable for orders in BR, SEA, MX (local sellers)
Split a buyer order of SKU A of quantity 2 and SKU B of quantity 1 into two separate packages:
  - ​​Package 1​​: all units of SKU A
​​  - Package 2​​: all units of SKU B

- **​​Case 2**: item-level split​​, applicable for orders in EU, JP, MX (global sellers), UK, US
Split the same order contents into three individual packages:
  - ​​Package 1​​: 1 unit of SKU A
​  - ​Package 2​​: 1 unit of SKU A
​​  - Package 3​​: 1 unit of SKU B

document_api_meta.title: Create Activity
document_api_meta.env_desc: Use this API to create a product discount activity or a flash deal activity. You cannot create a coupon activity with this API. To do that, you'll need to go to the seller center or the seller app. To update the products or SKUs included in the activity, use [Update Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650d32c42aaa3602b86ccb5c).

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: title
request_body_param.desc: Unique name across all your activities. The length must not exceed 50 characters.

request_body_param.name: activity_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of activities.
Possible enumerations:
- `FIXED_PRICE`: product discount activity with fixed price.
- `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`: product discount activities with percentage off.
- `FLASHSALE`: flash sale activity.
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`: shipping fee discount.
- `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`: Buy more save more discount.
- `BUY_X_GET_Y`: Buy X get Y.

request_body_param.name: product_level
request_body_param.desc:
Activity product dimension, values are:
​- PRODUCT: Promotion activity applies at the product (SPU) level. Any and all SKUs that are part of this product will be subject to the promotion.
​- VARIATION: Promotion activity only applies to specified SKUs.
​- SHOP: Promotion activity applies to all products in the shop.
When `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`, the `product_level` can not be `VARIATION`.
To set the products or SKUs covered by the activity, use [Update Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650d32c42aaa3602b86ccb5c).

request_body_param.name: duration_type
request_body_param.desc:
The effective time type of the current activity
- NORMAL:  `begin_time` and `end_time` must be filled
- INDEFINITE: `begin_time` and `end_time` aren't required, and the promotion will be a long-term activity which runs indefinitely. 
1.  `INDEFINITE` is only valid when `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`,
2. If `duration_type` is `INDEFINITE`, `start_time` and `end_time` should be 0
Default: NORMAL

request_body_param.name: begin_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity start time. UNIX timestamp. The value must be greater than the value of the current time.

request_body_param.name: end_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity end time. UNIX timestamp.

request_body_param.name: participation_limit
request_body_param.desc: The number of times a buyer can participate in the promotion.

request_body_param.name: ^type
request_body_param.desc:
Determines whether the promotion activity limits the number of times each buyer can receive its benefit. e.g.:
- `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`: No limit for buyer​s. Buyers can benefit from this promotion across multiple orders.
- `BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE`: Buyers can benefit from this promotion activity for no more than one order.
​Default: `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`

request_body_param.name: discount
request_body_param.desc: Discount information.

request_body_param.name: ^shipping_discount
request_body_param.desc: Shipping Discount

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NO_THRESHOLD`: No minimum purchase criteria. 
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.
`MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY` and `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT` can only be set when `product_level==SHOP`.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the threshold type, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of benefit awarded by the promotion activity. 
-When `FREE_SHIPPING`, the buyer's cost of shipping is reduced to zero.
​-When `DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, the discount is reduced by the value specified in `shipping_discount.value`.

request_body_param.name: ^^value
request_body_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `discount_type==FREE_SHIPPING`, this value is not required.
- `discount_type==DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, this value is the maximum amount deducted from the buyer's price of shipping in local currency. 
The value should be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^shipping_method
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
- When `STANDARD_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
- `EXPRESS_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
- `ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD`: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers.
Default: `STANDARD_SHIPPING`

request_body_param.name: ^^inventory_type
request_body_param.desc:
The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
- `SELF_FULFILLED`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
- `FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
- `ALL`:  Applies to all inventory of eligible products.
Default: `SELF_FULFILLED`
`FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK` and `ALL` can only be set when `product_level`==`SHOP` and `threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD`.

request_body_param.name: ^^area_scope
request_body_param.desc: The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies.

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The (buyer's) geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
​- `WHOLE`: Promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment. 
- `SPECIFIC_AREAS`: Only applies to specific fulfillment areas, as defined in `area_scope.specific_areas`

request_body_param.name: ^^^specific_areas
request_body_param.desc: The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. The list of valid values for each shop region are available here: [link](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e3b059e7dc4f04a4ff9e09)

request_body_param.name: ^bmsm_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions

request_body_param.name: ^^details
request_body_param.desc:
Configurations regarding BMSM promotions. 
A maximum of two `tier`s are permitted. `details.threshold_type` and `details.discount_type` must be the same across all `tier`s.

request_body_param.name: ^^^tier
request_body_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` and `discount_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. 
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`20` and `discount_value`== `15`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `20` and `discount_value`>`15`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the `threshold_type`, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by `value`.
Possible enumerations are:
​- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`​: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products.

request_body_param.name: ^^^value
request_body_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.desc:
The type of activities.
Possible enumerations:
- `FIXED_PRICE`: product discount activity with fixed price.
- `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`: product discount activities with percentage off.
- `FLASHSALE`: flash sale activity.
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`: shipping fee discount.
- `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`: Buy more save more discount.

response_param.desc:
The effective time type of the current activity
- NORMAL:  `begin_time` and `end_time` must be filled
- INDEFINITE: `begin_time` and `end_time` aren't required, and the promotion will be a long-term activity which runs indefinitely. 
1.  `INDEFINITE` is only valid when `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`,
2. If `duration_type` is `INDEFINITE`, `start_time` and `end_time` should be 0
Default: NORMAL

response_param.desc: Activity start time. UNIX timestamp. The value must be greater than the value of the current time.

- `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`: No limit for buyer​s. Buyers can benefit from this promotion across multiple orders.
- `BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE`: Buyers can benefit from this promotion activity for no more than one order.
​Default: `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`

response_param.desc:

- NOT_START: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users until the set activity start time.
- ONGOING: Promotion activities with this status are available to TikTok users.

- VARIATION: SKU level promotion activity.
- SHOP: Shop level promotion activity.

response_param.desc:

response_param.name: ^^shipping_discount
response_param.desc: Shipping discount

response_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
response_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NO_THRESHOLD`: No minimum purchase criteria. 
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.
`MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY` and `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT` can only be set when `product_level==SHOP`.

response_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
response_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the threshold type, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of benefit awarded by the promotion activity. 
- `FREE_SHIPPING`, the buyer's cost of shipping is reduced to zero.
​- `DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, the discount is reduced by the value specified in `shipping_discount.value`.

response_param.name: ^^^value
response_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `discount_type==FREE_SHIPPING`, this value is not required.
- `discount_type==DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, this value is the maximum amount deducted from the buyer's price of shipping in local currency. 
The value should be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^shipping_method
response_param.desc:
The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
- When `STANDARD_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
- `EXPRESS_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
- `ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD`: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers.
Default: `STANDARD_SHIPPING`

response_param.name: ^^^inventory_type
response_param.desc:
The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
- `SELF_FULFILLED`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
- `FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
- `ALL`:  Applies to all inventory of eligible products.
Default: `SELF_FULFILLED`
`FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK` and `ALL` can only be set when `product_level`==`SHOP` and `threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD`.

response_param.name: ^^^area_scope
response_param.desc: The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies.

response_param.name: ^^^^type
response_param.desc:
The (buyer's) geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
​- `WHOLE`: Promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment. 
- `SPECIFIC_AREAS`: Only applies to specific fulfillment areas, as defined in `area_scope.specific_areas`.

response_param.name: ^^^^specific_areas
response_param.desc: The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. response_param.name: ^^^^tier
response_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` and `discount_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier.

document_api_meta.title: Get Coupon
document_api_meta.env_desc: Use this API to get the full details of a coupon matching the {coupon_id}.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^coupon
response_param.desc: Coupon.

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: A unique ID that identifies different coupons.

response_param.name: ^^title
response_param.desc: Seller-specified title of the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^display_type
response_param.desc:
The display type of coupons.
Values:
- `REGULAR`: Regular coupons which are displayed to TikTok users across all display locations available in TTS, including PLPs, PDPs, TikTok Videos, LIVE Rooms, Creator Showcases, and may be shared via TTS Customer Support instant messages. Includes coupons which target select customer segments.
- `LIVE`: Coupons which are only displayed to TikTok users in LIVE Rooms.
- `CREATOR_EXCLUSIVE`: Coupons that can be claimed through the display channels of the specified creator, such as their LIVE Rooms, and their Creator Showcase.
- `CHAT`: Exclusive coupons that may be sent to customers via TTS customer support chat messages, but are not displayed in other display locations.
- `PROMO_CODE`: Promo codes do not have dedicated display locations on TikTok, but may be shared with customers in LIVEs, in TikTok videos, or other social media platforms. They can be claimed by customers entering a claim code at checkout or by customers that use a custom promo code landing page URL.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc:
Coupon's promotion status.
Values:
- `NOT_START`: Not available to TikTok users until the coupon's configured start time.
- `ONGOING`: Available to TikTok users.
- `EXPIRED`: Not available to TikTok users because it has expired.
- `DEACTIVATED`: Deactivated by the seller and is not available to TikTok users.

response_param.name: ^^create_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp of when the coupon was created.

response_param.name: ^^update_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp of when the coupon was updated.

response_param.name: ^^claim_duration
response_param.desc: Claimable period of the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^^start_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp from which a shopper can claim the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^^end_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp after which a shopper can no longer claim the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^redemption_duration
response_param.desc: Period during which the coupon can be redeemed (i.e. applied to an order).

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
Values:
- `ABSOLUTE`: the redemption period starts from `start_time` and ends at `end_time`.
- `RELATIVE`: the redemption period starts from the time the coupon is claimed and lasts for `relative_time`.

response_param.name: ^^^start_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp at which the redemption period starts, if `type == 'ABSOLUTE'`.

response_param.name: ^^^end_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp at which the redemption period ends, if `type == 'ABSOLUTE'`.

response_param.name: ^^^relative_time
response_param.desc: The number of days after coupon claim time for which a coupon is valid to be redeemed, `type = 'RELATIVE'`.

response_param.name: ^^display_channels
response_param.desc:
The channels in which the coupons can be displayed or distributed:
- `ALL`: All channels.
- `SHOPPING_CENTER`: Only in TikTok Shop shopping center.
- `CHAT`: Only in TT chat.
- `LIVE`: Only in TT live.
- `PRIVATE`: For promotion code. TikTok users won't know the codes until you show them.
- `VIDEO`: Only in short videos.
- `SHOWCASE`: Only in showcases.

response_param.name: ^^promo_code
response_param.desc: Promotion code. The string contains only Unicode letters or digits. The length of the string is in the range of `[6, 12]`.

response_param.name: ^^target_buyer_segment
response_param.desc:
The target buyer segment of the coupon. Possible enumerations are:
- `ALL`: May be discovered and claimed by all TTS buyers.
- `NEW`:Customers who have never purchased from your shop.
- `REPEAT_CUSTOMERS`: People who have previously placed orders in your shop and made another purchase within certain days(30 days for non-US and 90 days for US).
- `RECENT_CUSTOMERS`: People who have made their first purchase in your shop in the past certain days(30 days for non-US and 90 days for US).
- `FREQUENT_CUSTOMERS`: Customers with more than 1 purchase within the last 90 days.
- `LAPSED_CUSTOMERS`: Customers with at least 1 purchase in the past 365 days but no purchases within the last certain days(90 days for non-US and 30 days for US).
- `NEW_FOLLOWERS`: People who started following the TikTok account of your shop in the past 30 days.
- `EXISTING_ACTIVE_FOLLOWERS`: People who followed the TikTok account of your shop and engaged with your shop through LIVE, short videos or product cards in the past 30 days.

response_param.name: ^^usage_limits
response_param.desc: Limitations for the use of the coupons.

response_param.name: ^^^single_buyer_claim_limit
response_param.desc: The number of times a single buyer can claim the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^^total_claim_limit
response_param.desc: The total number of claims allowed for the coupon across all buyers.

response_param.name: ^^^redemption_limit
response_param.desc: The number of times that a claimed coupon can be redeemed across all buyers. (Only available in ID, MY, PH, TH, SG, VN regions.)

response_param.name: ^^usage_stats
response_param.desc: Usage statistics

response_param.name: ^^^claimed_count
response_param.desc: The number of times that the coupon has been claimed.

response_param.name: ^^^redeemed_count
response_param.desc: The number of times that a coupon has been redeemed (i.e. applied to an order).

response_param.name: ^^discount
response_param.desc: Discount

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of discount offered by the coupon. Possible enumerations are:
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Reduces the final price of the item by the specified `reduction_amount`
- `PERCENT_OFF`: Reduces the final price by the specified `percentage`.

response_param.name: ^^^reduction_amount
response_param.desc: Will appear when `type == 'AMOUNT_OFF'`.

response_param.name: ^^^^amount
response_param.desc: Monetary value of an `AMOUNT_OFF` discount.

response_param.name: ^^^^currency
response_param.desc: Currency of the discount amount.

response_param.name: ^^^percentage
response_param.desc: The discount offered by the coupon, in percentage points. Will appear when `type == PERCENT_OFF'`.

response_param.name: ^^^max_discount
response_param.desc: Optional monetary upper limit of the total discount amount when `type == ""PERCENT_OFF""`.

response_param.name: ^^^^amount
response_param.desc: Monetary value of the `max_discount`.

response_param.name: ^^^^currency
response_param.desc: Currency of the `max_discount`.

response_param.name: ^^threshold
response_param.desc: Optional minimum purchase criteria that must be met in order to receive the coupon's discount.

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NONE`: No minimum purchase criteria.
- `MIN_SPEND`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.

response_param.name: ^^^min_spend
response_param.desc: When `threshold.type == 'MIN_SPEND'`, a customer must purchase products from the range defined by `product_scope` with a monetary amount greater than or equal to this value, or the customer cannot use the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^^^amount
response_param.desc: Monetary value of the `min_spend`.

response_param.name: ^^^^currency
response_param.desc: Currency of the `min_spend` threshold.

response_param.name: ^^product_scope
response_param.desc:
The range of the products which the coupon applies to. The possible enumerations are:
- `FULL_SHOP`: All products sold in the shop are eligible for the coupon.
- `SPECIFIC_PRODUCTS`: Only specified products are eligible for the coupon. The list of specified products are returned in the response of the `get_coupon` API.

response_param.name: ^^product_ids
response_param.desc: The IDs of the eligible products when `product_scope == 'SPECIFIC_PRODUCTS'`.

response_param.name: ^^seller_tnc
response_param.desc: Custom terms & conditions optionally uploaded by the seller when configuring the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^creation_source
response_param.desc:
The system where the coupon is created:
- `SELLER_CENTER`: Created via the Promotions section of TikTok Seller Center.
- `SELLER_APP`: Created via the TikTok Seller Mobile App.
- `TTS_CRM`: Created via the TikTok Shop CRM.

response_param.name: ^^live_tasks
response_param.desc: The tasks which the shopper must fulfill before claiming the coupon distributed in TikTok live. Only exists for LIVE coupons in the US and the UK.

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
Possible enumerations:
- `NONE`: Any shopper in the LIVE room may claim the coupon.
- `FOLLOW_HOST`: Shoppers must follow the LIVE host before being able to claim the coupon.
- `WATCH_FOR_MIN_TIME`: Shoppers must watch the LIVE for the time specified by `min_watch_time` before being able to claim the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^^min_watch_time
response_param.desc: Number of seconds for which the shopper must watch the LIVE in order to claim the coupon.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:

Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: status
request_body_param.desc:
Activity status.
Possible values:
- DRAFT: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users.
- NOT_START: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users until the set activity start time.
- ONGOING: Promotion activities with this status are available to TikTok users.
- EXPIRED: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users because it has expired.
- DEACTIVATED: The activity has been deactivated by the seller and is not available to TikTok users.

request_body_param.name: activity_title
request_body_param.desc: Activity title key words. No fuzzy matching.

request_body_param.name: page_size
request_body_param.desc: Page size. The range is `[0, 100]`. `50` by default.

request_body_param.name: page_token
request_body_param.desc: Specify the value for the page. Use `""` for the first page.

request_body_param.name: activity_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of activities. If `activity_type`  isn't passed, return activities of all types. Possible values:
The type of activities.
Possible values:
- `FIXED_PRICE`
- `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`
- `FLASHSALE`
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`
- `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data

response_param.name: ^total_count

response_param.name: ^^title
response_param.desc: Activity name (50 characters max).

response_param.name: ^^activity_type
response_param.desc:
The type of activities.
Possible values:
- `FIXED_PRICE`
- `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`
- `FLASHSALE`
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`

response_param.name: ^^duration_type
response_param.desc:
The effective time type of the current activity
- NORMAL:  `begin_time` and `end_time` must be filled
- INDEFINITE: `begin_time` and `end_time` aren't required, and the promotion will be a long-term activity which runs indefinitely. 
1.  `INDEFINITE` is only valid when `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`,
2. If `duration_type` is `INDEFINITE`, `start_time` and `end_time` should be 0
Default: NORMAL

response_param.name: ^^begin_time
response_param.desc: Activity start time. UNIX timestamp. The value must be greater than the value of the current time.

response_param.name: ^^end_time
response_param.desc: Activity end time. UNIX timestamp.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc:
Activity status.
Possible values:
- DRAFT: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users.
- NOT_START: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users until the set activity start time.
- ONGOING: Promotion activities with this status are available to TikTok users.
- EXPIRED: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users because it has expired.
- DEACTIVATED: The activity has been deactivated by the seller and is not available to TikTok users.
- NOT_EFFECTIVE:  The activity is terminated by the platform and is not available to TikTok users.

response_param.name: ^^create_time
response_param.desc: The time when the activity was created.

response_param.name: ^^update_time
response_param.desc: The time when the activity was last updated.

response_param.name: ^^product_level
response_param.desc:
Activity product dimension, values are:
​- PRODUCT: Promotion activity applies at the product (SPU) level. Any and all SKUs that are part of this product will be subject to the promotion.
​- VARIATION: Promotion activity only applies to specified SKUs.
​- SHOP: Promotion activity applies to all products in the shop.

response_param.name: ^^activity_commands
response_param.desc:
Applicable commands to the activity: 
- IMMUTABLE: The activity cannot be edited or deactivated.

response_param.name: ^^participation_limit
response_param.desc: The number of times a buyer can participate in the promotion.

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
Determines whether the promotion activity limits the number of times each buyer can receive its benefit. e.g.:
- `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`: No limit for buyer​s. Buyers can benefit from this promotion across multiple orders.
- `BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE`: Buyers can benefit from this promotion activity for no more than one order.
​Default: `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`

response_param.name: ^^discount
response_param.desc: Discount information.

response_param.name: ^^^shipping_discount
response_param.desc: Shipping Discount

response_param.name: ^^^^threshold_type
response_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NO_THRESHOLD`: No minimum purchase criteria. 
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.
`MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY` and `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT` can only be set when `product_level==SHOP`,

response_param.name: ^^^^threshold_value
response_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the threshold type, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of benefit awarded by the promotion activity. 
- `FREE_SHIPPING`, the buyer's cost of shipping is reduced to zero.
​- `DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, the discount is reduced by the value specified in `shipping_discount.value`.

response_param.name: ^^^^value
response_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- `discount_type==FREE_SHIPPING`, this value is not required.
- `discount_type==DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, this value is the maximum amount deducted from the buyer's price of shipping in local currency. 
The value should be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^^shipping_method
response_param.desc:
The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
- When `STANDARD_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
- `EXPRESS_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
- `ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD`: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers.
Default: `STANDARD_SHIPPING`

response_param.name: ^^^^inventory_type
response_param.desc:
The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
- `SELF_FULFILLED`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
- `FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
- `ALL`:  Applies to all inventory of eligible products.
Default: `SELF_FULFILLED`
`FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK` and `ALL` can only be set when `product_level`==`SHOP` and `threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD`.

response_param.name: ^^^^area_scope
response_param.desc: The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies

response_param.name: ^^^^^type
response_param.desc:
The (buyer's) geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
​- `WHOLE`: Promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment. 
- `SPECIFIC_AREAS`: Only applies to specific fulfillment areas, as defined in `area_scope.specific_areas`

response_param.name: ^^^^^specific_areas
response_param.desc: The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. The list of valid values for each shop region are available here: [link](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e3b059e7dc4f04a4ff9e09)

response_param.name: ^^^bmsm_discount
response_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions

response_param.name: ^^^^details
response_param.desc:

A maximum of two `tier`s are permitted. `details.threshold_type` and `details.discount_type` must be the same across all `tier`s.

response_param.name: ^^^^^tier
response_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` and `discount_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. 
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`20` and `discount_value`== `15`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `20` and `discount_value`>`15`.

response_param.name: ^^^^^threshold_type
response_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

response_param.name: ^^^^^threshold_value
response_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the `threshold_type`, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by `value`.
Possible enumerations are:
​- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`​: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products.

response_param.name: ^^^^^value
response_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

response_param.name: ^^^gift_discount
response_param.desc: Configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. Only needs to be configured for GWP promotions.

response_param.name: ^^^^gift_receiving_type
response_param.desc:

-`ALL_RECEIVE`: All gifts configured in the promotion can be collected.

response_param.name: ^^^^gift_infos
response_param.desc:

- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). response_param.name: ^^^^^gift_details

response_param.desc: The quantity limit of the gift sku which is involved in the activity. The range is [1, 99999].  If you are updating the value of an existing sku, the value cannot be decreased.

response_param.name: ^^^bxgy_discount
response_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy X Get Y (BXGY) promotions. Only needs to be configured for BXGY promotions.

document_api_meta.title: Search Coupons
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Use this API to get a list of coupons, narrowed down further based on search parameters. 
The coupons are created in Seller Center or Seller App.
For further details of the specific coupon, use `GET Coupon`.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: Page cursor. Omitting this parameter will return the first page of results.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc: The number of coupons returned in one page of results. The range is `[1, 100]`, with a default value of `50`.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: status
request_body_param.desc:
Coupon's promotion status.
Values:
- `NOT_START`: Not available to TikTok users until the coupon's configured start time.
- `ONGOING`: Available to TikTok users.
- `EXPIRED`: Not available to TikTok users because it has expired.
- `DEACTIVATED`: Deactivated by the seller and is not available to TikTok users.

request_body_param.name: title_keyword
request_body_param.desc: Keywords in the coupon titles to search for. The range of the length is `(0, 100]`. Fuzzy matching not supported.

request_body_param.name: display_type
request_body_param.desc:
The display type of coupons.
Values:
- `REGULAR`: Regular coupons which are displayed to TikTok users across all display locations available in TTS, including PLPs, PDPs, TikTok Videos, LIVE Rooms, Creator Showcases, and may be shared via TTS Customer Support instant messages. Includes coupons which target select customer segments.
- `LIVE`: Coupons which are only displayed to TikTok users in LIVE Rooms.
- `CREATOR_EXCLUSIVE`: Coupons that can be claimed through the display channels of the specified creator, such as their LIVE Rooms, and their Creator Showcase.
- `CHAT`: Exclusive coupons that may be sent to customers via TTS customer support chat messages, but are not displayed in other display locations.
- `PROMO_CODE`: Promo codes do not have dedicated display locations on TikTok, but may be shared with customers in LIVEs, in TikTok videos, or other social media platforms. They can be claimed by customers entering a claim code at checkout or by customers that use a custom promo code landing page URL.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^total_count
response_param.desc: Total coupon count.

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: Page cursor for next request. The last page returns "".

response_param.name: ^coupons
response_param.desc: Coupons.

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: A unique ID that identifies different coupons.

response_param.name: ^^title
response_param.desc: Seller-specified title of the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^display_type
response_param.desc:
The display type of coupons.
Values:
- `REGULAR`: Regular coupons which are displayed to TikTok users across all display locations available in TTS, including PLPs, PDPs, TikTok Videos, LIVE Rooms, Creator Showcases, and may be shared via TTS Customer Support instant messages. Includes coupons which target select customer segments.
- `LIVE`: Coupons which are only displayed to TikTok users in LIVE Rooms.
- `CREATOR_EXCLUSIVE`: Coupons that can be claimed through the display channels of the specified creator, such as their LIVE Rooms, and their Creator Showcase.
- `CHAT`: Exclusive coupons that may be sent to customers via TTS customer support chat messages, but are not displayed in other display locations.
- `PROMO_CODE`: Promo codes do not have dedicated display locations on TikTok, but may be shared with customers in LIVEs, in TikTok videos, or other social media platforms. They can be claimed by customers entering a claim code at checkout or by customers that use a custom promo code landing page URL.

response_param.name: ^^status
response_param.desc:
Coupon's promotion status.
Values:
- `NOT_START`: Not available to TikTok users until the coupon's configured start time.
- `ONGOING`: Available to TikTok users.
- `EXPIRED`: Not available to TikTok users because it has expired.
- `DEACTIVATED`: Deactivated by the seller and is not available to TikTok users.

response_param.name: ^^create_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp of when the coupon was created.

response_param.name: ^^update_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp of when the coupon was updated.

response_param.name: ^^claim_duration
response_param.desc: Claimable period of the coupon

response_param.name: ^^^start_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp from which a shopper can claim the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^^end_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp from which a shopper can claim the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^redemption_duration
response_param.desc: Period during which the coupon can be redeemed (i.e. applied to an order).

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
Values:
- `ABSOLUTE`: the redemption period starts from `start_time` and ends at `end_time`.
- `RELATIVE`: the redemption period starts from the time the coupon is claimed and lasts for `relative_time`.

response_param.name: ^^^start_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp at which the redemption period starts, if `type == 'ABSOLUTE'`.

response_param.name: ^^^end_time
response_param.desc: The UNIX timestamp at which the redemption period ends, if `type == 'ABSOLUTE'`.

response_param.name: ^^^relative_time
response_param.desc: The number of days after coupon claim time for which a coupon is valid to be redeemed, `type = 'RELATIVE'`.

response_param.name: ^^promo_code
response_param.desc: Promotion code. The string contains only Unicode letters or digits. The length of the string is in the range of `[6, 12]`.

response_param.name: ^^target_buyer_segment
response_param.desc:
The target buyer segment of the coupon. Possible enumerations are:
- `ALL`: May be discovered and claimed by all TTS buyers.
- `NEW`:Customers who have never purchased from your shop.
- `REPEAT_CUSTOMERS`: People who have previously placed orders in your shop and made another purchase within certain days(30 days for non-US and 90 days for US).
- `RECENT_CUSTOMERS`: People who have made their first purchase in your shop in the past certain days(30 days for non-US and 90 days for US).
- `FREQUENT_CUSTOMERS`: Customers with more than 1 purchase within the last 90 days.
- `LAPSED_CUSTOMERS`: Customers with at least 1 purchase in the past 365 days but no purchases within the last certain days(90 days for non-US and 30 days for US).
- `NEW_FOLLOWERS`: People who started following the TikTok account of your shop in the past 30 days.
- `EXISTING_ACTIVE_FOLLOWERS`: People who followed the TikTok account of your shop and engaged with your shop through LIVE, short videos or product cards in the past 30 days.

response_param.name: ^^usage_limits
response_param.desc: Limitations for the use of the coupons.

response_param.name: ^^^single_buyer_claim_limit
response_param.desc: The number of times a single buyer can claim the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^^total_claim_limit
response_param.desc: The total number of claims allowed for the coupon across all buyers.

response_param.name: ^^^redemption_limit
response_param.desc: The number of times that a claimed coupon can be redeemed across all buyers. (Only available in ID, MY, PH, TH, SG, VN regions.)

response_param.name: ^^discount
response_param.desc: Discount.

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of discount offered by the coupon. Possible enumerations are:
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Reduces the final price of the item by the specified `reduction_amount`
- `PERCENT_OFF`: Reduces the final price by the specified `percentage`.

response_param.name: ^^^reduction_amount
response_param.desc: Will appear when `type == 'AMOUNT_OFF'`.

response_param.name: ^^^^amount
response_param.desc: Monetary value of an `AMOUNT_OFF` discount.

response_param.name: ^^^^currency
response_param.desc: Currency of the discount amount.

response_param.name: ^^^percentage
response_param.desc: The discount offered by the coupon, in percentage points. Will appear when `type == PERCENT_OFF'`.

response_param.name: ^^^max_discount
response_param.desc: Optional monetary upper limit of the total discount amount when `type == ""PERCENT_OFF""`.

response_param.name: ^^^^amount
response_param.desc: Monetary value of the `max_discount`.

response_param.name: ^^^^currency
response_param.desc: Currency of the `max_discount`.

response_param.name: ^^threshold
response_param.desc: Optional minimum purchase criteria that must be met in order to receive the coupon's discount.

response_param.name: ^^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NONE`: No minimum purchase criteria.
- `MIN_SPEND`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.

response_param.name: ^^^min_spend
response_param.desc: When `threshold.type == 'MIN_SPEND'`, a customer must purchase products from the range defined by `product_scope` with a monetary amount greater than or equal to this value, or the customer cannot use the coupon.

response_param.name: ^^^^amount
response_param.desc: Monetary value of the `min_spend`.

response_param.name: ^^^^currency
response_param.desc: Currency of the `min_spend` threshold.

response_param.name: ^^product_scope
response_param.desc:
The range of the products which the coupon applies to. The possible enumerations are:
- `FULL_SHOP`: All products sold in the shop are eligible for the coupon.
- `SPECIFIC_PRODUCTS`: Only specified products are eligible for the coupon. The list of specified products are returned in the response of the `get_coupon` API.

response_param.name: ^^creation_source
response_param.desc:
The system where the coupon is created:
- `SELLER_CENTER`: Created via the Promotions section of TikTok Seller Center.
- `SELLER_APP`: Created via the TikTok Seller Mobile App.
- `TTS_CRM`: Created via the TikTok Shop CRM.

You can also change the discounts on existing products or SKUs. To remove the products or SKUs from the list, use [Remove Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650acfd84a0bb702c072b4eb).

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token

Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_body_param.desc:
Limit of product purchase per buyer. The range is `[1, 99]`, or you can use `-1` for unlimited. If you are updating the value of an existing product, the value cannot be less than the current value.
When `product_level==VARIATION`, you must specify `-1`.

request_body_param.name: ^skus

request_body_param.desc:
Deal price.

request_body_param.name: ^^discount

Discount value. If the SKU is 10% off, the value is `10`.

scope_list.package_description: The Partner will be able to create and manage seller's discounts and promotions on TikTok Shop.
scope_list.auth_info: The Partner will be able to create and manage your discounts and promotions on TikTok Shop.

document_api_meta.title: Update Activity
document_api_meta.env_desc: Change the title and the beginning and end time of the existing product discount or flash sale promotion activity.

request_header_param.name: content-type
request_header_param.desc: Allowed type: application/json

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: title
request_body_param.desc: Activity name (50 characters max). The name must be unique.

request_body_param.name: duration_type
request_body_param.desc:
The effective time type of the current activity
- NORMAL:  `begin_time` and `end_time` must be filled
- INDEFINITE: `begin_time` and `end_time` aren't required, and the promotion will be a long-term activity which runs indefinitely. 
1.  `INDEFINITE` is only valid when `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`,
2. If `duration_type` is `INDEFINITE`, `start_time` and `end_time` should be 0
Default: NORMAL

request_body_param.name: begin_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity start time. UNIX timestamp. The value must be greater than the value of the current time.

request_body_param.name: end_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity end time. UNIX timestamp.

request_body_param.name: product_level
request_body_param.desc:
Activity product dimension, values are:
​- PRODUCT: Promotion activity applies at the product (SPU) level. Any and all SKUs that are part of this product will be subject to the promotion.
​- VARIATION: Promotion activity only applies to specified SKUs.
​- SHOP: Promotion activity applies to all products in the shop.

request_body_param.name: participation_limit
request_body_param.desc: The number of times a buyer can participate in the promotion.

request_body_param.name: ^type
request_body_param.desc:
Determines whether the promotion activity limits the number of times each buyer can receive its benefit. e.g.:
- `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`: No limit for buyer​s. Buyers can benefit from this promotion across multiple orders.
- `BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE`: Buyers can benefit from this promotion activity for no more than one order.
​Default: `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`

request_body_param.name: discount
request_body_param.desc: Discount information.

request_body_param.name: ^shipping_discount
request_body_param.desc: Shipping discount

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NO_THRESHOLD`: No minimum purchase criteria. 
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.
`MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY` and `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT` can only be set when `product_level==SHOP`.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the threshold type, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of benefit awarded by the promotion activity. 
- `FREE_SHIPPING`, the buyer's cost of shipping is reduced to zero.
​- `DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, the discount is reduced by the value specified in `shipping_discount.value`.

request_body_param.name: ^^value
request_body_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `discount_type==FREE_SHIPPING`, this value is not required.
- `discount_type==DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, this value is the maximum amount deducted from the buyer's price of shipping in local currency. 
The value should be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^shipping_method
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
- When `STANDARD_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
- `EXPRESS_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
- `ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD`: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers.
Default: `STANDARD_SHIPPING`

request_body_param.name: ^^inventory_type
request_body_param.desc:
The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
- `SELF_FULFILLED`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
- `FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
- `ALL`:  Applies to all inventory of eligible products.
Default: `SELF_FULFILLED`
`FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK` and `ALL` can only be set when `product_level`==`SHOP` and `threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD`.

request_body_param.name: ^^area_scope
request_body_param.desc: The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The (buyer's) geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
​- `WHOLE`: Promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment. 
- `SPECIFIC_AREAS`: Only applies to specific fulfillment areas, as defined in `area_scope.specific_areas`

request_body_param.name: ^^^specific_areas
request_body_param.desc: The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. The list of valid values for each shop region are available here: [link](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e3b059e7dc4f04a4ff9e09)

request_body_param.name: ^bmsm_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions

request_body_param.name: ^^details
request_body_param.desc:
Configurations regarding BMSM promotions. 
A maximum of two `tier`s are permitted. `details.threshold_type` and `details.discount_type` must be the same across all `tier`s.

request_body_param.name: ^^^tier
request_body_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` and `discount_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. 
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`20` and `discount_value`== `15`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `20` and `discount_value`>`15`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the `threshold_type`, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by `value`.
Possible enumerations are:
​- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`​: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products.

request_body_param.name: ^^^value
request_body_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^gift_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. Only needs to be configured for GWP promotions.

request_body_param.name: ^^gift_receiving_type
request_body_param.desc:
The receiving type of gift. Currently only supports one type: `ALL_RECEIVE`
-`ALL_RECEIVE`: All gifts configured in the promotion can be collected.

request_body_param.name: ^^gift_infos
request_body_param.desc:
Configurations regarding Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. 
A maximum of two `tier`s are permitted in SEA and UK. Only one `tier` is permitted in US.  And `threshold_type` must be the same across all `tier`s.

request_body_param.name: ^^^tier
request_body_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. 
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`2`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `2`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold type of discount. The threshold type of each tier must be consistent. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold value of the gift, based on the `threshold_type`. Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible product subtotal for the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified order value in local currency (e.g. buyer's order subtotal must be at least $3 to receive the benefit). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^^gift_details
request_body_param.desc: Gift configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^product_id
request_body_param.desc: TikTok Shop product id of gift.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^sku_id
request_body_param.desc: TikTok Shop sku id of gift.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^total_claim_limit
request_body_param.desc: The quantity limit of the gift sku which is involved in the activity. The range is [1, 99999].  If you are updating the value of an existing sku, the value cannot be decreased.

request_body_param.name: ^bxgy_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy X Get Y (BXGY) promotions. Only needs to be configured for BXGY promotions.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on the `threshold_type`, e.g., "3". Determined by user.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (e.g. must purchase 3 or more eligible products to receive the benefit). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.

request_body_param.name: ^^discount_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by `value`.
Possible enumerations are:
​- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`​: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- `FREE`: Buyer will receive X eligible products for free.
- `AMOUNT_OFF_EACH`: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price on each of eligible products.

request_body_param.name: ^^discount_value
request_body_param.desc:

- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF_EACH`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of each eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^benefit_max_applicable_quantity
request_body_param.desc: The quantity of item Y in a BXGY promotion. This value must be a positive integer.

request_body_param.name: ^^benefit_max_applicable_times
request_body_param.desc: Optional. The maximum number of times the BXGY benefit can be applied within a single order. This value must be a positive integer.

request_body_param.name: target_user_info

request_body_param.name: ^user_type

- AVAILABLE: the response includes campaigns the partner is permitted to join.
- JOINED: the response includes campaigns the partner has joined only.

document_api_meta.title: Create Target Collaboration

This API is used to create a target collaboration.
A target collaboration is a collaboration between a seller selected set of products (including a commission payout) and a set of creators the seller has added (invited) to the collaboration. request_body_param.name: ^^minimum_follower_count
